title: Manage one local preview
responsibility: Keeps one preview running and reuses it when the same app starts again.

inputs.name: PreviewServerService.constructor.port
inputs.description: Loopback port on 127.0.0.1 that reserves the one preview slot, so processes that should share a preview must use the same port; when the bind fails with EADDRINUSE, run() reads the owner record served on this port. Defaults to previewOwnerPort: 47840.

inputs.name: PreviewServerService.run.identity
inputs.description: Fingerprint of the checkout and selected history data, published in the owner record that later processes compare exactly, so a different value is rejected instead of reused; that record must stay within 2048 characters. Only the first run() call on an instance uses it, because later calls return the same promise.

inputs.name: PreviewServerService.run.start
inputs.description: Starts the preview only after this process owns the slot, and it must resolve to a handle whose url is exactly http://127.0.0.1:<port>, because reusing processes reject any other form. If it rejects or throws, run() closes this process’s listener and rejects with that same error.

outputs.name: PreviewServerService.run
outputs.description: The preview url and whether it was reused: reused is false when this process bound the slot and started the preview, and true when the url was taken from the process that already owned the slot.

outputs.name: PreviewServerService.close
outputs.description: Releases only this process’s preview and ownership listener after any pending run() settles, and a reusing process leaves the owner running; repeated calls return the same promise.

errors.name: listen error with a code other than EADDRINUSE
errors.description: Any error from binding 127.0.0.1 on this port whose code is not EADDRINUSE, such as a permission error or an invalid port; run() rejects with it before start() is called, so no preview starts.

errors.name: Error: Preview ownership port is occupied by another application.
errors.description: Thrown by previewOwner() when the port answers with a non-2xx status, a body longer than 2048 characters, or a protocol other than harness-preview-v1; run() rejects with it instead of reusing that port.

errors.name: Error: Invalid preview owner address.
errors.description: Thrown by previewOwner() when the owner record’s url is not null and does not match http://127.0.0.1:<digits>; run() rejects with it instead of reusing that port.

errors.name: Error: A different Harness preview is already running at ${owner.url ?? 'startup'}. Close it before switching checkout or history data.
errors.description: Thrown by previewOwner() when the owner record’s identity differs from this run’s identity; the message names the owner’s url, or 'startup' while it is still null. run() rejects with it instead of reusing that port.

errors.name: Error: The existing Harness preview is still starting; no duplicate was launched.
errors.description: Thrown by previewOwner() after 100 attempts in which the owner with the same identity still has a null url, with a 100 ms wait after each attempt. run() rejects with it and starts no preview.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A TypeError from previewOwner() when the request to the occupied port fails to connect, gets a redirect response that redirect: 'error' refuses, or its body cannot be read. A body that parses to the JSON value null also throws a TypeError when its protocol is read; run() rejects with it unchanged.

errors.name: TimeoutError
errors.description: A DOMException named TimeoutError from previewOwner() when a request to the occupied port, or reading its body, takes longer than 1000 ms. previewOwner() does not retry it, so run() rejects with it unchanged.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: A SyntaxError from JSON.parse in previewOwner() when a 2xx body of at most 2048 characters is not valid JSON. run() rejects with it unchanged.

errors.name: start() rejection
errors.description: Whatever start() rejects with or throws, passed through unchanged: run() closes this process’s listener, rejects with that same error, and later run() calls on this instance return that same rejection.

errors.name: PreviewHandle.close() rejection
errors.description: The rejection of the started handle’s close(), passed through unchanged: close() still closes this process’s listener in a finally block, then rejects with that same error.
